components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single main action per screen: New sale, Checkout, Add medicine.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12h14"/><path d="M12 5v14"/></svg>New sale</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: oklch(50% 0.105 195); color: oklch(98.5% 0.005 200); font: 600 14px/1 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(20% 0.03 250 / 30%); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(45% 0.105 195); box-shadow: 0 2px 6px oklch(20% 0.03 250 / 25%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(58% 0.12 190 / 50%); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions beside the primary; hover fills muted.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: oklch(100% 0 0); color: oklch(17% 0.02 250); font: 500 14px/1 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(88.5% 0.009 240); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(95.5% 0.005 235); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(58% 0.12 190 / 50%); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Status Badge — Zone Ok
components.description: Zone chips carry a leading dot and a tinted ring; critical variants pulse the dot.
components.html: In stockLow stockExpired
components.css: .ds-chip-ok, .ds-chip-caution, .ds-chip-critical { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font: 500 12px/1 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip-ok { background: oklch(62% 0.15 165 / 10%); color: oklch(40% 0.12 165); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(62% 0.15 165 / 20%); } .ds-chip-caution { background: oklch(75% 0.16 75 / 10%); color: oklch(50% 0.16 75); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(75% 0.16 75 / 25%); } .ds-chip-critical { background: oklch(55% 0.2 25 / 10%); color: oklch(48% 0.19 25); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(55% 0.2 25 / 20%); } .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; } .ds-chip-critical .ds-dot { animation: ds-pulse 2.2s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.35; } }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: 32px height, 12px radius, teal focus ring, teal caret.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; } .ds-input-wrap svg { position: absolute; left: 12px; color: oklch(46% 0.015 250); pointer-events: none; } .ds-input { height: 32px; width: 260px; padding: 0 12px 0 36px; font: 400 14px Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; color: oklch(17% 0.02 250); background: transparent; border: 1px solid oklch(88.5% 0.009 240); border-radius: 12px; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; caret-color: oklch(50% 0.105 195); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(46% 0.015 250); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: oklch(58% 0.12 190); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(58% 0.12 190 / 50%); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav — Active Item
components.description: The wayfinding 'you are here' marker: accent pill, teal icon, outer indicator bar.
components.html: InventoryDashboard
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 4px 12px; } .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 12px; font: 500 14px Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; color: oklch(46% 0.015 250); text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: oklch(95.5% 0.005 235); color: oklch(17% 0.02 250); } .ds-nav-item.ds-active { background: oklch(93% 0.025 195); color: oklch(32% 0.075 195); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(20% 0.03 250 / 8%), inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(50% 0.105 195 / 10%); } .ds-nav-item.ds-active svg { color: oklch(50% 0.105 195); } .ds-nav-item.ds-active::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -12px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 4px; height: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(50% 0.105 195); }

components.css: .ds-kpi { background: oklch(100% 0 0); border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(0% 0 0 / 7%); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-kpi:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(0% 0 0 / 7%), 0 2px 4px oklch(20% 0.03 250 / 6%), 0 16px 40px -16px oklch(20% 0.03 250 / 25%); } .ds-kpi-top { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-kpi-label { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(46% 0.015 250); } .ds-kpi-icon { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 12px; background: oklch(50% 0.105 195 / 10%); color: oklch(50% 0.105 195); } .ds-kpi-value { margin: 0; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.03em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: oklch(17% 0.02 250); } .ds-kpi-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-delta-up { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; background: oklch(62% 0.15 165 / 10%); color: oklch(40% 0.12 165); } .ds-kpi-hint { font-size: 12px; color: oklch(46% 0.015 250); }

narrative.overview: MediFlow AI looks like the signage of a well-run hospital: every surface is a legible zone, every number is oversized and unambiguous, and the state of the store is readable from across the counter in color alone. It refuses the generic neutral SaaS dashboard in favor of a clinical white / deep slate ground where one signage-teal accent marks the primary action and a green / amber / rose zone language carries meaning. The system is Operate-first: density and speed at the counter, calm trust at the desk. Expression never obscures the task.
keyCharacteristics: Oversized tabular numerals for anything countable.
One accent (signage teal) for primary actions, selection, and focus — never decoration.
Color zones (emerald / amber / rose / sky) shared by badges, deltas, and chart fills.
Hairline rings with soft lifted shadows on hover; elevation declared once per element.
Browser surfaces themed: selection, scrollbar, caret, focus rings.
Motion is 150–250ms state feedback; the one authored moment is the KPI count-up.

rules.name: The Zone Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, rose, and sky are a shared vocabulary — a stock badge, a KPI delta, and a chart slice that say the same thing use the same hue. Never invent a fifth status color.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Signage teal is used on ≤ 10% of any screen: primary actions, the active nav pill, selection, and focus. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Size Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is carried by size and weight alone. No kicker, eyebrow, or small-caps label above a heading; no gradient or colored emphasis text.

rules.name: The One-Elevation Rule
rules.body: A surface declares one elevation language: hairline rings for grid-connected surfaces, shadow-card for free-floating panels; hover lifts interactive tiles with shadow-lifted. The ghost card does not exist here.

dos: Do use the four zones for anything status-like, reusing the exact hue for the badge, delta, and chart of the same state.
Do render every countable figure in tabular numerals at the largest sensible size.
Do declare elevation once per element — ring at rest, lifted shadow on hover.
Do keep motion at 150–250ms for state feedback; reserve the count-up for KPI figures.
Do theme the browser's surfaces (selection, scrollbar, caret) from the palette.
donts: Don't add a kicker/eyebrow above a heading, gradient text, or colored emphasis type — weight and size carry hierarchy.
Don't use glass or blur as decoration; it is reserved for the sticky header's scroll-under effect.
Don't scatter decorative sparklines, progress rings, or identical icon-heading-text card rows as page structure.
Don't invent a fifth status color or reach for brand hues outside the zone set for status.
Don't replace standard affordances (modals, selects, scrollbars) with custom flavor.
